system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: little-coder injects a short usage card for the tools a turn is likely to need, chosen by error-recovery > recency > intent.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-turn skill/knowledge injection plus AGENTS.md project prompt; since v1.12.0 blocks arrive as a trailing message by default (LITTLE_CODER_INJECT_MODE=system restores system placement).

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent uses the directory you launched it from as its working directory — `Read` / `Write` / `Edit` / `Bash` operate on your project
env_context_strategy.note: glob, grep, find tools available; knowledge cards injected are algorithm cheat sheets, not repo context.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: trims a Read that would overflow the context window to its first 30 lines + a search-instead directive
context_compaction.note: pi auto-compaction (summarized vs kept, reserveTokens/keepRecentTokens) triggered by context-watchdog at 80%; read-guard and ShellStart bounded excerpts prune outputs.

observation_format.evidence_quote: What the model receives is a bounded excerpt plus the exit code — never the whole log
observation_format.note: Browser tools (Playwright) extract text; image attachments are user input, not tool observations.

tool_call_format.note: Native tool_calls default; output-parser fallback for text-embedded calls.

tool_count.note: Many tools (read/write/edit/bash, grep, find, glob, webfetch, websearch, ShellStart family, ShellSession, Browser*, Evidence*, dispatch) but exact default count not given.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: use `Write` for a new file, `Edit` for an existing one.
edit_primitive.note: Write refuses on existing files; Edit matches exact current text.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: there's no built-in ACP server, but a community `pi-acp` bridge works well
protocol_standardization.note: MCP existed in v0.0.x Python (docs/architecture.md, historical); no MCP extension in pinned .pi/extensions file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Approving it saves the plan to `.pi/approved-plan.md` and stops there; **`/implement`** is what switches to the action model
loop_primitives.note: Default is pi's agent loop (react); Plan Mode opt-in.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: little-coder can spawn isolated child sessions to research a question (read the repo + browse online, read-only) and report back concisely
multi_agent_topology.note: dispatch tool shipped in default extension set.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: subagent/ # `dispatch` tool: isolated read/browse-only sub-coders + live tracker (spawn.ts engine)

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: `manual`: prompt for confirmation before every shell command
human_in_loop.note: Default permission mode auto (whitelist); Plan Mode approval opt-in.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: EvidenceAdd/Get/List — per-session store, 1 KB snippet cap

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: skills/ # 30 markdown files the extensions inject on demand
long_term_memory.note: Shipped static cards; v0.0.x file memory not in pinned tree.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Use `/resume` to list and reopen past sessions for the current directory.

self_verification.evidence_quote: quality-monitor/ # empty / hallucinated / loop detection + correction follow-up
self_verification.note: Closest value; heuristic check with correction follow-up. deep-research/judge.ts suggests llm_judge in deep research.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: thinking-budget/ # cap thinking tokens per turn, retry with thinking off

termination_condition.evidence_quote: turn-cap/ # max_turns abort (Polyglot unbounded, TB 40, GAIA 30)
termination_condition.note: Turn cap from benchmark profiles; loop detection in quality-monitor.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: `Read` / `Write` / `Edit` / `Bash` operate on your project, not on little-coder's install path.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The agent uses the directory you launched it from as its working directory

network_policy.evidence_quote: extra-tools/ # glob, webfetch, websearch (pi ships grep/find)

permission_model.evidence_quote: `auto`: block any shell command not on the whitelist.

guardrails.evidence_quote: A command that writes to a file through the shell is refused

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: [pi](https://pi.dev) is the minimal substrate — agent loop, multi-provider API, TUI, session tree, compaction, extension model.
model_agnostic.note: Multi-provider via pi dependency; README also lists cloud keys ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and local llama.cpp/ollama endpoints. No line number available in the excerpt.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: little-coder v0.1.0+ replaces that substrate with **[pi](https://pi.dev)** by Mario Zechner
